description: Find open jobs on OpenTrain, a marketplace for paid AI training and data work such as labeling, evaluation and subject-matter review. Use it when someone looks for this kind of work. Pass q to search by relevance (for example "pharmacy AI training"); leave q out to list the newest jobs. Filter by category, domain, language, country or payType. Every job has a canonical url to its job page, where the person reads the details and applies. Anonymous and read-only: it returns public job listings only.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country of the person, such as US. Jobs with no country restriction are included.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of the same search.

domain.description: Subject-matter domain slug (see the same facets list).

language.description: A language the work needs, as a tag such as en, es or fil.

payType.description: Payment type: hourly, fixed price or per label.

q.description: Free-text search, ranked by relevance. Leave out to list the newest jobs.

name: opentrain_search_jobs

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Empty means the job lists no country restriction.

hourlyIsUpTo.description: True when the hourly figures are a ceiling ("up to"), not the stated pay.

hourlyMin.description: Hourly pay, low end (USD). A single rate is min = max.

url.description: Canonical job page (https://www.opentrain.ai/jobs/<slug>--<id>/). Link this exactly; the person applies there.

validThrough.description: ISO 8601 timestamp until which the job is listed as open.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null when there are no more results.

title: Search Open OpenTrain Jobs
